title: The Other White Meat
notes: This chunk builds a tight, law-positive case for the swine as the outward-only counterfeit, chaining Leviticus tests through Hebrew Matthew, Asaph, Gadarene, prodigal, Peter, and Isaiah into Revelation and the other gospel. Strengths include precise Hebrew wordplay (_karsam_, _chazir_, _ta'am_, _basar_) and consistent symbol assembly without modern dilution. Issues are concentrated house-style breaches: multiple author sentences open with That/And/But, and residual presenter staging ('Mark its', 'mark that', 'Now hear', 'Now set', 'Now weigh') that undercut the dense assertive voice. A few long sentences risk tangling the evidence-to-claim seam but remain readable. No doctrine or quote alterations needed; the text is otherwise clean and on-register.

This chunk closes the beast material with a tight Ezekiel 4 reading and a clean return to the food-law similitude of chewing the cud. Short paragraphs, law-positive density, and intact scripture markup are strengths; the Hosea parallel and the two-assemblies contrast land cleanly. The sole clear defect is residual presenter staging in the recap sentence that begins “You have now watched.” That line violates the ban on director cues and should be recast as a plain assertion. No sentence-open violations, AI vocabulary, or quote errors appear. The glossary pointer works as a natural exit.

proposals.old: That is why it cannot tell pearls from slop: what has no second chewing has no taste — and the law says so in its own vocabulary, for the __“jewel of gold in a swine's snout”__ hangs on __“a fair woman which is without *discretion*”__ (Proverbs 11:22), and the word under _discretion_ is *ta'am* — **taste**, the very word of __“O *taste* and see that the LORD is good”__ (Psalm 34:8).
proposals.new: It cannot tell pearls from slop: what has no second chewing has no taste — and the law says so in its own vocabulary, for the __“jewel of gold in a swine's snout”__ hangs on __“a fair woman which is without *discretion*”__ (Proverbs 11:22), and the word under _discretion_ is *ta'am* — **taste**, the very word of __“O *taste* and see that the LORD is good”__ (Psalm 34:8).
proposals.summary: Remove sentence-initial That from author prose.
proposals.rationale: House style forbids author sentences starting with That. Minimal cut preserves the claim and the following evidence chain.

proposals.old: Mark its verb: _karsam_, __“doth waste”__ — it stands nowhere else in the Hebrew Bible, and it is about to reappear.
proposals.new: Its verb is _karsam_, __“doth waste”__ — it stands nowhere else in the Hebrew Bible, and it is about to reappear.
proposals.rationale: Presenter staging of the Mark that family is banned. Direct assertion keeps the rare-verb claim intact.

proposals.old: And __“lest they trample”__ reads __“lest they *chew* them”__ — and mark that verb: _karsam_ stands exactly *once* in the whole Hebrew Bible, at the boar in Asaph's vine.
proposals.new: The phrase __“lest they trample”__ reads __“lest they *chew* them”__ — the verb _karsam_ stands exactly *once* in the whole Hebrew Bible, at the boar in Asaph's vine.
proposals.summary: Fix And-open and embedded mark that cue.
proposals.rationale: Author prose cannot open with And; mark that is banned staging. Rephrase asserts the same Hebrew link without either defect.

proposals.old: Now hear Mark set the scene:
proposals.rationale: Director cues of the Now hear family violate house style. Direct statement preserves the transition into the Mark quotation.

proposals.old: Now set Isaiah's swine-eaters beside a phrase of Revelation.
proposals.new: Isaiah's swine-eaters stand beside a phrase of Revelation.
proposals.rationale: Imperative staging is banned. Declarative form keeps the comparison claim and the following Revelation link.

proposals.old: That is the swine's structure stated as ecclesiology: the outward sign worn, the inward work absent — Romans 2:28-29's outward Jew, gathered into a body.
proposals.new: This is the swine's structure stated as ecclesiology: the outward sign worn, the inward work absent — Romans 2:28-29's outward Jew, gathered into a body.
proposals.rationale: House style forbids That at the start of author prose. This preserves the exact claim and the Romans cross-link.

proposals.old: But the picture itself never becomes food.
proposals.new: The picture itself never becomes food.
proposals.rationale: Author prose cannot open with But. The assertion stands cleanly without the conjunction.

proposals.old: Now weigh what the whole case makes of the command itself.
proposals.new: The whole case makes this of the command itself.
proposals.rationale: Weigh the family of cues is explicitly banned. Direct claim matches the Living the Similitude section and leads into the Hosea evidence.

proposals.old: You have now watched the beast from every side — at the vine, under the pearls, among the tombs, at the trough, in the mire, and inside the gates claiming the name.
proposals.new: The beast has been shown from every side — at the vine, under the pearls, among the tombs, at the trough, in the mire, and inside the gates claiming the name.
proposals.summary: Remove second-person director cue that recaps prior viewing.
proposals.rationale: House style forbids presenter staging such as “Now watch”; “You have now watched” is the same register. A direct assertion preserves the summary without the cue.
